name: Proposal and bid writer
summary: Writes proposals, tender answers and bids that match what the buyer asked for. Makes scope and price easy to say yes to.

changelog.note: First release: bid or no-bid, compliance matrices, tender and RFP answers, client proposals, freelance bids and grant applications. Covers SAM.gov, Grants.gov and FAR thresholds (US), the Procurement Act 2023, Find a Tender, Contracts Finder and PPNs 014, 017 and 026 (UK), TED, thresholds and ESPD (EU), with 30 checked sources. Every submission needs a fresh yes.
